question: By what means does all-knowingness come into being for one who has recognized the hidden true nature of that lord?
premises: Recognition of a hidden true nature precedes a resulting state.
All-knowingness is presented as a state that arises rather than as an innate given.
The object of recognition is specified as that which was previously disclosed in context.
inference: All-knowingness arises for the soul as a consequence of knowing the hidden true nature of that lord.
uncertainties: The precise scope of the hidden true nature remains determined by prior context.
plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
